title: The Geometry of Agent Memory: Forecasting Retrieval-Bound Memory Failures, and Characterizing Its Limits
abstract: arXiv:2610.26433v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study whether geometric relationships between conversation turns, memory texts, and queries can predict answer correctness before generation. We evaluate four memory implementations with dense or hybrid retrieval and one observation-summary comparator. We embed these texts in a shared space. A logistic classifier uses 25 features describing query proximity, memory-conversation correspondence, and conversation structure. On LongMemEval-small, pooled AUROC is 0.640 over 2,367 question-system pairs, below a question-difficulty baseline of 0.655. Performance varies by question type: geometry reaches 0.841 on single-session-assistant questions, but system identity alone reaches 0.826. After controlling for difficulty and identity, geometry adds no statistically established pooled improvement (delta = +0.002, 95% CI [-0.010, 0.014]). translated_title: 智能体记忆的几何学：预测检索相关的记忆失效，并刻画其局限性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了对话轮次、记忆文本和查询之间的几何关系能否在生成答案之前预测答案的正确性。我们评估了四种采用稠密或混合检索的记忆实现，以及一个观察-摘要对比基线。我们将这些文本嵌入到共享空间中。一个逻辑回归分类器使用25个特征来描述查询邻近性、记忆-对话对应关系和对话结构。在LongMemEval-small数据集上，2,367个问题-系统配对的合并AUROC为0.640，低于问题难度基线的0.655。性能因问题类型而异：几何特征在单会话助手类问题上达到0.841，但仅凭系统身份即可达到0.826。在控制问题难度和系统身份因素后，几何特征未带来统计学上成立的合并改进（delta = +0.002，95%置信区间[-0.010, 0.014]）。固定存储的上下文选择实验发现，使用按邻近度排序的记忆能获得比...更高的准确率（原文截断）。
tldr: 该研究用对话、记忆与查询之间的几何关系特征来预测智能体记忆系统的检索失效，但发现其整体预测能力不及简单的问题难度基线，且在控制问题难度和系统身份后，几何特征并未带来统计学上显著的性能提升。
en_tdlr: This study uses geometric relationships between conversation turns, memory texts, and queries to forecast retrieval-bound memory failures in agent systems, finding that overall prediction falls below a simple question-difficulty baseline and geometry provides no statistically established improvement after controlling for question difficulty and system identity.
